claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_size
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Large Form's core effect is a temporary self-size change to Large. Existing atoms can modify speed, checks, and ability scores, but none can represent becoming Large without overclaiming with polymorph-style replacement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_level_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is a species trait that only unlocks starting at character level 5. SpeciesTraitRecord has no acquired-at level field or mechanics-side eligibility gate, so the authored surface cannot represent when the trait becomes available.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: duration_end_manual_no_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect has a timed duration that can also end early at the user's option with no action. Current activated-ability duration supports timed windows but not an explicit owner-driven early end.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required).

discrepancies: no content/species_goliath_large_form.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
